The '''Khomr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The [[Khomri tapestry]] was from this system.
